policy: Positive manual everyday-word selection; lowercase ASCII 2–8 letters; no proper names, abbreviations, obscure specialist terms, slurs, sexual or violent terms. Not a claim of exhaustive context-sensitive moderation.

excludedDraftEntries.apprise: Unnecessarily formal for everyday early practice.
excludedDraftEntries.zonal: Technical adjective; other z words provide everyday coverage.
excludedDraftEntries.april: Proper month name would need a capital.
excludedDraftEntries.cozy: American variant omitted from this single British-spelling corpus.
excludedDraftEntries.auto: Clipped form; avoid ambiguity about abbreviations.
excludedDraftEntries.army: Military topic omitted from this quiet practice selection.
excludedDraftEntries.remix: Absent from the pinned tier-50 British extract.

scopeNote: The candidate input was written independently as everyday vocabulary and checked against pinned ESDB. The final generic supplement was not selected because the earlier manually reviewed groups already provided sufficient vocabulary and all stage coverage.
